notes: OWNER RULING, TRANSCRIBED. Mats reviewed the interim chain on 2026-09-06 and required exactly one correction: THM-0104 as first recorded (fingerprint sha256:5addbb430123a6d840e46280b24b86f1977bd02ac54125c76c61471dc52d674f) OVERCLAIMED shutdown safety, and this record replaces it. THE DEFECT: InFlightGuard is taken before the body read and held through handler(..).await to the response, and the drain exits when the count reaches zero OR the grace deadline expires, so runtime teardown after grace expiry can cancel a task suspended INSIDE the handler, not only one still reading its body. THREE CLAIMS ARE THEREFORE WITHDRAWN, by the owner's words: that a request which reached the handler runs to completion and is answered; that every admitted request ends answered or never executed; and that retry of an abandoned request is safe because the handler was never entered. WHAT IS CLAIMED NOW is the property the mechanism establishes: shutdown stops new admission; admitted work is counted until its task ends; the drain waits on that count until zero or grace expiry; if the grace expires the remaining work may be cancelled wherever it is suspended; a cancelled task is never polled again, so nothing executes or resumes after serve returns; and the drain mechanism alone makes NO claim about whether cancelled work crossed the exchange or application execution threshold. THAT CORRESPONDENCE BELONGS TO THE EXCHANGE-STATE AND RETRY AUTHORITIES, not to the drain counter, and the security consequence now says so. NO PRODUCTION CODE CHANGED: the ruling is explicit that production must not be redesigned to preserve the stronger theorem unless measurement independently finds a product requirement demanding it, and none was found — drain_grace >= request_deadline remains the documented configuration relation giving a zero-abandoned drain in fact, resting on the request deadline's own enforcement. THE BATTERY IS UNCHANGED and still measures what it measured; what changed is the sentence it is evidence for. One narrowing is recorded in the scope: a_request_abandoned_by_the_grace_never_reaches_the_handler exercises a request stalled in its BODY READ, so it establishes terminal cancellation for a task short of the handler, not that every abandoned task is short of the handler. The wall-clock exclusions, the lane identity (async_serve, measured with and without RUST_TEST_THREADS=1 on 2026-09-06), the structural cancellation half carrying no probe, and the deliberate absence from every root's closure on THM-0012's precedent are unchanged from the prior record. THM-0104 has no dependents and is outside every root closure, so this correction moves its own review fingerprint and nothing else. The fingerprint was recomputed on the tree after the last edit and equals the value above. Reviewed tree: theorem/thm-0104-correction on main 99a5eae6.
